title: Support recovers the subset index
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $a:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\mathrm{Fin}(2)$, the index that is $1$ on the support of $a$ (the coordinates where $a$ is nonzero) and $0$ elsewhere equals $a$.
